t: Holiday Music Discs can be found in chests throughout the Overworld, or can be dropped when a Skeleton kills a Creeper.
节日音乐唱片可在主世界的宝箱中找到，或由骷髅击杀苦力怕后掉落。
The Red Disc plays an assortment of Lofi Holiday Songs by LofiGeek.
红色唱片播放由LofiGeek创作的一系列轻松假日歌曲。
The Green Disc plays more traditional Holiday music.
绿色唱片播放更为传统的节日音乐。
